rows.name: B1 the supervisor probe is the IMMUTABLE-record probe bound to one run dir, not the legacy `READY.json` default (which the V1.18+ worker can never publish)

rows.name: B2 a worker whose READY lands at ~2 s and whose batch then runs past the 60 s initialization cap (while staying under the 180 s batch cap) is NOT misjudged as an init timeout

detail.note: this fixture SHORTENS the cap to 3 s so the check costs seconds, not a minute; the production cap stays 60.0 and is asserted unchanged in B7

arm_layer_fail_closed.why: the wall limit is passed to the run, so the ARM overruns and fails closed; in production both this limit and the supervisor cap are the frozen 10 s

rows.name: B4 a state exceeding the pre-registered 10 s is handled at BOTH real layers: the arm degrades fail-closed to the original plan with `timeout`, and the supervisor terminates the tree so the round stops instead of the overrun passing unnoticed
